metadata.attribution: Datos provistos por el laboratorio de meteorología CEAZA
metadata.description: CEAZA-Met stations with a snow sensor (depth, SWE or snow weight), Coquimbo and Atacama Andes, Chile. Raw logger data, not quality controlled; ceaza_sensor_plan says which sensor the archive uses for which dates.

properties.name: Guandacol
properties.operator: Centro de Estudios Avanzados en Zonas Áridas (CEAZA)
properties.data_provider: CEAZA-Met (Datos provistos por el laboratorio de meteorología CEAZA)
properties.notes: Datos provistos por el laboratorio de meteorología CEAZA (https://www.ceazamet.cl/). No licence is stated; the terms of use ask users to register a user name and to credit the source with a link. Raw logger output, not quality controlled.

data_variables.name: ta_c:HDCTA
data_variables.description: Air temperature; value is the interval mean.
data_variables.notes: value_min / value_max are the interval extremes. Values outside −60 to 50 °C are nulled. Sensor HDCTA at 2.0 m; daily = the service's mean over the UTC−4 day.

data_variables.name: ani_cm:HDCAN
data_variables.description: Snow depth from an automatic snow-depth sensor.
data_variables.notes: Raw logger values. Bare ground often reads slightly negative (zero offset); those values are nulled by the 0–15 m bound, not set to zero. El Tapado has two sensors (TPFSNOWD to 2023, TPFANSHM31 from 2018). Sensor HDCAN at 2.85 m; daily = the service's mean over the UTC−4 day.

data_variables.name: pnkg:HDCPN
data_variables.description: Snow weight per unit area (Guandacol HDCPN, Llano de Las Liebres LLLSW1Wins1h and LLLSW2Wins1h), i.e. SWE: 1 kg/m² = 1 mm of water.
data_variables.notes: Published in kg/m²; returned as SWE in cm (× 0.1). The two Llano de Las Liebres sensors disagree: on days when either reads over 10 kg/m² the median difference is 32 kg/m² and the largest 182 kg/m² (2024-08-02). Sensor HDCPN at 0.0 m; daily = the service's mean over the UTC−4 day.

data_variables.name: pp_mm:TASCPP
data_variables.description: Precipitation total over the interval (the service sums).
data_variables.notes: Only Tascadero (TASCPP) among the snow stations. The gauge type is not given by the service. A partial day (data_pct < 100) undercounts. Not the cumulative ppa_mm gauge level, which is not served. Sensor TASCPP at 1.5 m; daily = the service's mean over the UTC−4 day.

data_variables.name: ae_mm:TASCPN
data_variables.description: Snow water equivalent from an automatic sensor (El Tapado TPFSWE_K and TPFSWE_TL, Tascadero TASCPN).
data_variables.notes: Published in mm; returned in cm (× 0.1). The sensor type is not given by the service. Summer values drift below zero and are nulled. El Tapado's two sensors disagree: median difference 15 mm, largest 210 mm, on days when either reads over 50 mm. Sensor TASCPN at 0.0 m; daily = the service's mean over the UTC−4 day.
